text:
maria_sales: Hey team — Sunrise wants a small POC using their finetuned fork + our runtime. They asked for: perf for a 4-bit quantized variant, KV-cache compatibility, security answers (SOC/KMS/data residency), and a short ops runbook. Can engineering + ML confirm feasibility and rough ETA?

sam_engineer: +1. Need model format and a sample checkpoint. is it PyTorch HF-pt or custom? Also want max seq len and vocab size.

eva_research: They said HF format, ~28B params, seq_len 2048. For 4-bit quant we need to know if they used block-wise quant or LLM.adam style. KV cache should be fine but we should validate kv-shape assumptions.

kevin_se: For pricing flags — will they be hosted or dedicated? If hosted POC, estimate ~ $0.015/token for peak inference (4-bit) unless we can batch well; dedicated commit changes numbers.

maria_sales: Initial ask is hosted POC for 2 weeks, then potential Dedicated for Q4 if perf looks good.

sam_engineer: Quick validation steps for ops: run the model validator (internal) and a smoke run. Paste this:
```bash
# validate model artifact (replace with their s3 link)
curl -X POST https://internal-validate.redwood.ai/models/validate \n  -F "artifact=@/tmp/sunrise-checkpoint.pt" \n  -F "target=hf"
```
If checksum + shape pass, we can try a perf harness.

priya_ops: Ops notes: we need a container image from them or build our adapter. Preferred flow: they provide HF tarball -> we run rwdctl build -> register in catalog. Example: 
```bash
rwdctl model register 
  --name sunrise-v1 
  --platform hf 
  --artifact s3://sunrise/poc/sunrise-v1.tar.gz 
  --image rwd-infer:stable-2026-03 
  --quant 4bit
```
Also need their license / redistribution ok.

nora_security: Security checklist items from their legal: encryption at rest (KMS ok), TLS for in-flight, audit logs, VPC peering option, and data residency in eu-west-1. They also want answers for model provenance and whether we store any customer prompts post-request.

kevin_se: Add pricing ask: if they commit to $X/month reserved for Dedicated we can offer 30% off hosted rates for POC transition. I'll draft numbers once Sam gives RPS/latency targets.

sam_engineer: Perf estimate (rough) for 28B on 4-bit, batch=1, seq=1024 on A10G-ish: p95 ~ 220ms per request token generation (decode path), throughput 55 tokens/s single replica. With dynamic batching and prefetched KV we can push to ~140 tokens/s.

eva_research: Also flag: attention pattern is cross-attn heavy? If yes, kernel selection might need fallback and could add 10-20% overhead. Ask them to run the small diagnostic (we can share script).

maria_sales: @sam_engineer @nora_security can you prepare: 1) a one-page perf expectation doc, 2) answers to the security questionnaire items (KMS, residency, logs), and 3) a short ops checklist for onboarding? Customer wants it by EOD Friday.

sam_engineer: I can do perf doc, ETA tomorrow morning.

nora_security: I'll assemble security answers and a sample DPA excerpt. quick Q: do we keep prompts for 30 days by default for quality monitoring? Ops can confirm.

priya_ops: We don't persist customer prompts unless they opt into analytics; default is ephemeral, logs contain only metadata. I'll put that in the runbook.

maria_sales: Great. Also they asked if we support adapter layers (LoRA/IA3). Any blockers?

eva_research: We support LoRA and several adapter patterns at serving time but need to bake the merged weights or runtime-level adapter support. For POC, ask them to supply merged weights to avoid runtime complexity.

sam_engineer: If they insist on on-the-fly adapters we need an extra 3-5 days to validate memory/KV interactions. Recommend merged weights.

maria_sales: I'll tell them merged weights preferred. Final ask: can someone drop a short example cmd to run a local smoke infer so they can validate latency on their side?

sam_engineer: Sure.

sam_engineer: 
```bash
# quick local smoke (uses our infer-client)
infer-client --model-path /path/to/sunrise.tar.gz --seq 512 --batch 1 --prompt "Hello world" --mode decode --warmup 5 --steps 50
```
Outputs avg latency and tokens/s.

deploy-bot: Job #45234: artifact scan complete — no risky licenses found (MIT/BSD/Apache detected).

maria_sales: Awesome — I'll send customer the perf doc + security answers tomorrow and ask for packaged artifact and checksum. Thanks all :raised_hands: 

kevin_se: I'll draft the POC pricing sheet after Sam posts p95/p50 numbers.

priya_ops: I'll stub the onboarding playbook and link to the catalog registration snippet.

maria_sales: Plan: ship docs tomorrow, schedule a sync w/ Sunrise on Mon. Thread closed unless blockers.
